the Pidgey flies to Lavender Town, landing below the Pokemon Center's door (6, 5), as 10.01. Celadon's Department Store sells no Hyper Potion (pokefirered: only Saffron's, Cinnabar's and the Sevii Marts do) and its 2F items clerk, whose best healing is the Super Potion, is on a floor the walker has no map of; Lavender's Mart sells the same Super Potion (700) a short walk from its landing (08.03)
along the street to the Mart's door (20, 15), in and up to face the clerk (2, 3) over the counter (3, 3), as 08.03

the errand's whole list at one Mart: Lavender stocks the Super Potion (700), the Antidote (100) and the Parlyz Heal (200), so no second Mart is visited (this row once flew back to Viridian's Mart for the status heals alone). The bag at 17.04b holds potion x3 and super-potion x0 (console B, 2026-11-15 22:10) against PokeGuy's potion x4, superpotion x4 at the Route 22 rival and his antidote x1, parlyzheal x2 for the League (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md; user's decision 2026-11-15); recovery_items() cures PSN and PAR with them. 11,000 in all from the ~$51,000 the save holds, so nothing is sold; if_affordable cuts a line to what a smaller purse covers
back out of the Mart's door (20, 15) onto the street below it, as 08.03
